summary: Turn 5. The previously submitted Candidate was accepted and then resolved: the TryPreAccept defer-cycle guard is inert but harmless because handlePrepareReply's sub-case 4 guard (epaxos/epaxos.go:1272) duplicates sub-case 3's (epaxos/epaxos.go:1269), so bcastTryPreAccept (called only under subCase == 4, epaxos/epaxos.go:1304-1306) and the whole TryPreAccept handling are unreachable; no defer cycle can arise. This turn adds a new, stronger Candidate on the decision-consumption path. Sourced discrepancy: handleCommit (epaxos/epaxos.go:1066-1113) may create a placeholder instance via newInstanceDefault, whose lb field is nil, and then dereferences inst.lb.clientProposals at epaxos/epaxos.go:1092 with no nil check, whenever commit.Replica == r.Id and the commit carries a single NOOP command. handlePrepareReply guards exactly that placeholder state (lb == nil at epaxos/epaxos.go:1210), so the nil-lb placeholder is expected in this codebase and the missing guard is a sourced asymmetry; the crash would occur in the replica's message goroutine with no recover, removing a participant. NOOP commands are produced by the recovery restart path (handlePrepareReply sub-cases 5/6 calling startPhase1 with state.NOOP(), epaxos/epaxos.go:1307-1312) and bcastCommit then sends them with Replica = row owner. Submitted action=continue with one new Candidate (disposition concrete_suspicion, preferred_check direct_test, priority 2): principal fact F-COMMITTED, direct behavior B-COMMIT, supporting B-PREPARE-REPLY-LEADER / B-PHASE1 / B-RECOVERY-START, activity_classes A5 with supported core activity A1. The open premise is explicit rather than assumed: whether a fault history can deliver a NOOP Commit for the receiver's own row while its local entry is a placeholder (row owner lost the instance, or learned it only via PreAccept/Accept, which never set lb). An analogous independent observation is retained separately: handlePrepareReply evaluates lb := inst.lb before its inst == nil check (epaxos/epaxos.go:1206-1210). Preflight validation returns valid=true; formal acceptance and any execution remain the controller's.
